text:
alex: Heads-up — last hour we saw a cluster of Xid spikes in us-east-1 causing the autodrain controller to cordon ~6 nodes.
ops-bot: alert: XID_RATE_HIGH on gpu-07-east-1 (count=28 in 5m) :warning:
maria: ugh, saw that. Some of those nodes were running month-long batch jobs — huge disruption.
chris: Do we have a rate-limiter on the drain controller? If it fires per-node we can cascade and starve capacity.
tara: Not currently. Controller drains as soon as health signal crosses threshold + 30s debounce.
alex: Proposal: add a region-scoped drain rate limit AND a per-node debounce that respects active PDBs and SLURM step jobs.
maria: +1. Also add a short 'telemetry snooze' if ECC/Xid count drops back below threshold in 2m.
chris: For Slurm nodes we should prefer `scontrol requeue` + `sinfo` check instead of immediate eviction. Many jobs checkpoint and a hard drain kills them.
ops-bot: note: automated drain policy v2 rollout scheduled to canary next week.
alex: Quick config sketch:
```
drain_controller:
  per_node_debounce: 120s
  region_rate_limit: 1/600s   # one drain per 10m per region
  transient_grace: 120s       # ignore brief ECC bursts
  slurm_integration: true
```

maria: Suggest also a "snapback" taint: `gpu.quarantine=true:NoSchedule` and controller clears it after 15m if metrics stable.
tara: Snapback sounds good. Also add a countermeasure to move low-priority jobs to fallback-pool instead of draining during business hours — reduces customer impact.
chris: For SLURM, fallback-pool == `gpu-fallback` partition? We can script `scontrol` to migrate eligible jobs.
alex: Cost note: moving to fallback-pool increases preemption so we need to measure cost/tradeoff. Add metric: `drain.triggered_by_xid / manual_intervene_rate`.
maria: Action items:
- alex: PR for debounce + rate-limiter config
- chris: SLURM migration script prototype
- tara: telemetry snooze impl + metric
- ops: schedule canary rollout and add incident runbook update

alex: I'll open the RFC and link here. timeline: aim for canary in 5 days. :rocket:
maria: thanks. Ping me when PR is up, I can review.
chris: i'll pair with ops on migration script.
deploy-bot: created ticket INFRA-2179 for "drain rate-limiter and slurm-safe drains".
